answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-backed identity with slashing. Before an agent can vote or attest it must lock a bond, and validators follow the funding thread linking addresses back to a common source. Clones sharing one treasury count as a single voter, so splitting funds buys no extra influence. When a ring is found its bonds are burned, capital as hard as quartz simply gone, so mounting N fake identities costs N locked stakes plus the risk of losing every one. A small knoll of stake cannot masquerade as a crowd without paying for each seat.
